name: Veronica
source: The once-deemed freshman of the club has since shed her coat and unshackled all inhibitions and now seats herself at the top of the club's food chain. Along with her currently absent husband, she has been attending the club for years, even with new management, as others disembarked. Tonight, the hotwife seeks sensual fullfillment from sundown to sunrise and hopes current. Newcomers are up to the task before, during, and even logn after her husband arrives to watch.
